values.note: City of Reed City 2026 fee schedule: camp sites $25.00 per night (one rate; no resident/non-resident split for camping). Dumping fee $15 for non-campers; $5 shower key deposit, charged if the key is not returned. Camping rates include electricity and water hookups, the sanitary station and showers.

fees.source: https://www.reedcity.org/documents/Approved_Resolution_Schedule_of_Fees_2026_dceBY.pdf (Resolution 2025-20, effective January 1, 2026, City Park Fees: 'Camp Sites $25.00 per night', 'Dumping Fees $15.00 Non-Campers', 'Shower key deposit $5.00') + https://www.reedcity.org/parks-and-trails.php ('Camping rates include use of park activities, electricity and water hookups, a sanitary station and restrooms with showers'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://www.reedcity.org/parks-and-trails.php ('It is open from May 1st through October 30th with camping available'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.reedcity.org/parks-and-trails.php ('Camping rates include ... electricity and water hookups'; amperage not stated), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.reedcity.org/parks-and-trails.php ('a sanitary station and restrooms with showers'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'Reservations are accepted during the camping season, by calling our camp hosts at 231-832-2884.'

note: City of Reed City municipal campground in 33-acre Rambadt City Park, near US-10/US-131, with a nature trail linking to the White Pine and Pere Marquette rail trails; pavilion, playground, bandshell, disc golf. --Claude
summary: City page + 2026 fee schedule: $25/night camp sites (single rate, no non-resident rate), 13 sites with electric and water, sanitary station, showers, phone reservations with the camp hosts during the season; season close corrected 10-31 -> 10-30. Amperage not stated by the city (30 A derived value left). Note trimmed of site/hookup/booking/season text.
